summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 4 new features: Knowledge base topic selector, stock media provider integration, and topic-steered content generation. Backend: 96.8% success (60/62 tests passed). Frontend: 100% success (all features working). Stock search correctly returns 400 when no API keys configured (expected behavior). Topic selectors working in both Blog and Newsletter Studios. One intermittent LLM JSON parsing issue found (not a code bug).

flaky_endpoints.issue: Intermittent 500 error with JSON parsing: 'Expecting ',' delimiter' when using topics parameter
flaky_endpoints.symptoms: LLM occasionally returns malformed JSON response
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Retry the request. This is an LLM response formatting issue, not a code bug. Batch generation with focus_topics works consistently.

minor_bugs.impact: Status update endpoint not working correctly
minor_bugs.note: Existing bug, not related to new features
